item.title: Tarana CEO still sees more BEAD opportunities
item.description: Tarana sees potential for broader BEAD wins for its fixed wireless clients as service providers that bid too aggressively potentially drop from the federal broadband program. 'BEAD isn't in any way over,' says CEO Basil Alwan.

item.title: Eurobites: MTN agrees to buy IHS Towers for $6.2B
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Ericsson partners with Microsoft, Mastercard; Connect Europe's still grousing about regulation; BICS combines with NUSO on cloud numbers.

item.title: Liberty Global to buy UK's Netomnia and Dutch Ziggo
item.description: Liberty Global, Telefónica and InfraVia intend to buy UK altnet Netomnia via their nexfibre JV, raising concerns about network overlap and competition, while Liberty is also buying Vodafone's 50% stake in Dutch VodafoneZiggo.

item.title: Sezzle Mobile launches unlimited plans that ride AT&T's network
item.description: Sezzle Mobile, an MVNO powered by Gigs that taps into the AT&T network, has launched unlimited 5G plans starting at $29.99 per month. #pressrelease

item.title: Liberty Global nabs Vodafone's stake in VodafoneZiggo
item.description: Liberty Global said it will acquire Vodafone's 50% stake in VodafoneZiggo for €1.0 billion in cash and a 10% equity interest in new Ziggo Group. Liberty's regional Benelux assets will be transferred into a new unit called Ziggo Group. #pressrelease

item.title: Nexfibre JV acquires Substantial Group for £2B
item.description: Nexfibre, a JV of InfraVia, Liberty Global and Telefónica, have acquired Substantial Group, an alternative fiber provider that's targeting 3.4 million fiber passings and more than 500,000 customers. #pressrelease

item.title: OIF details multivendor demos at OFC
item.description: OIF member experts present panels on CEI-448Gbps signaling, next-generation ZR optics and optical interconnect specs for AI. #pressrelease

item.title: Arrcus boasts of bookings growth, new AI network fabric
item.description: Arrcus said its new Arrcus Inferencing Network Fabric (AINF) is a purpose-built solution that enables the delivery of Inferencing applications, avoiding network bottlenecks. #pressrelease

item.title: SpaceX and MTN connect on government deals
item.description: MTN said it has partnered with SpaceX to provide government satellite connectivity services via SpaceX's low Earth orbit (LEO) platform #pressrelease

item.title: There's pent-up demand for upstream capacity on DOCSIS networks – study
item.description: OpenVault's latest 'Broadband Insights' report showed there's a sizable disparity in upstream data consumption between FTTP and DOCSIS networks, suggesting there's latent demand for upstream capacity on DOCSIS platforms.
